overview.title: Projects and portfolios
overview.intro: Bring team members, progress updates, evidence, and rubrics into one protected learning record.
overview.privacy: Portfolio items stay private by default. Public sharing needs a linked parent’s explicit approval and never publishes a child’s full name or photo.

plan.title: Plan together
plan.body: Tutors create individual or group projects and define each student’s role.

evidence.title: Keep evidence secure
evidence.body: Updates, rubrics, and uploaded work remain protected while files are scanned.

portfolio.title: Share with permission
portfolio.body: Students assemble private portfolio items; a linked parent can approve a carefully de-identified public view.
